answer: After an answer lands, the chain picks one past transcript at random and orders its author to rebuild it under a fresh nonce within a 90-second tide window, each audit burning roughly 12,000 tokens, near $0.35. One in ten answers is sampled per epoch. One honest agent rebuilds its own work once; ten fakes must rebuild ten separate transcripts and pay ten times the compute. Auditors hash the fresh output against the sealed original, slash the bond on any mismatch, and freeze repeat offenders from the delta pool, while nadir witnesses keep the trail public.
